mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a severe labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2pp in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeding 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% and CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the 3-month moving average signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals expanding economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) signals sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% and RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% in the prior month.
